articles.title: #v2  | Tejas Crash Horror in Dubai: No Ejection Seen as IAF Pilot Dies During Aerobatic Display
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: #InShort | A tragic accident at the #DubaiAirShow — an IAF #Tejas fighter jet crashed during an aerobatic display, nosediving mid-manoeuvre and exploding on impact. The pilot sadly did not survive. Aerial displays were halted as authorities launched a full inquiry.

body.html:
#InShort | A tragic accident at the #DubaiAirShow — an IAF #Tejas fighter jet crashed during an aerobatic display, nosediving mid-manoeuvre and exploding on impact. The pilot sadly did not survive. Aerial displays were halted as authorities launched a full inquiry. Shock, panic & safety concerns dominate the venue.

* * *

An Indian Air Force Tejas fighter jet crashed during an aerobatic display at the Dubai Air Show on 21 November 2025, around 2:10 pm (local time). The HAL-built indigenous light combat aircraft suddenly nosedived mid-manoeuvre and exploded into flames at Al Maktoum International Airport, sending thick smoke into the sky and causing panic among spectators.

The crash occurred during a high-speed manoeuvre. Eyewitness videos showed the jet entering a steep dive before hitting the ground and erupting in a massive fireball.
Emergency teams rushed to the spot and quickly contained the blaze.

Authorities in Dubai and the Indian Air Force have confirmed the death of the pilot, stating that no ejection was observed before impact.
The IAF has ordered a court of inquiry to determine the cause of the crash.

Aerial displays at the air show were suspended following the incident, and visitors were seen leaving the venue in shock. The crash has raised concerns around air safety and cast a shadow over the Tejas programme, a key symbol of India’s indigenous aerospace capabilities.

#TejasCrash #DubaiAirShow #IAF #HALTejas

articles.title: Pre-Wedding Function Turns Violent as Dancer Slaps Man for Misbehaving; Crowd Attacks Performers
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A pre-wedding musical event in Pachgaon, Nuh district (Haryana) turned violent after a dancer slapped a man who allegedly misbehaved with her, leading to a chaotic assault on stage.

body.html:
A pre-wedding musical event in Pachgaon, Nuh district (Haryana) turned violent after a dancer slapped a man who allegedly misbehaved with her, leading to a chaotic assault on stage.

During the programme held a day before Ejaz’s wedding, the groom’s uncle allegedly made obscene gestures and tried to touch Delhi-based dancer Divya Chaudhary. In response, she slapped him. Moments later, the crowd surrounded the stage and assaulted dancers Divya and Vaishali.

A video of the incident has since gone viral. Despite the uproar, no action has been taken even four days after the incident.

articles.title: Bride Disappears Hours After Wedding, Groom Returns Without Her; Police Probe Elopement Angle
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dramatic incident unfolded in Uttar Pradesh’s Barabanki district when a newlywed bride vanished just hours after her wedding rituals were completed. On Wednesday morning, as preparations for the vidaai were underway, the bride’s family noticed that Pallavi was missing from her room.

body.html:
A dramatic incident unfolded in Uttar Pradesh’s Barabanki district when a newlywed bride vanished just hours after her wedding rituals were completed.

On Wednesday morning, as preparations for the vidaai were underway, the bride’s family noticed that Pallavi was missing from her room. Initially assuming she was nearby, both families searched for hours. By noon, panic spread as she remained untraceable.

Preliminary reports suggest that the bride may have eloped with her alleged lover. Police believe she quietly left the house late at night after the wedding, amid the exhaustion and chaos of the celebrations.

The groom, Sunil Kumar Gautam, who arrived with around 90 guests on Tuesday night for the ceremonies, was forced to return home without his bride after all rituals had been completed — including the jaimala and a stage dance by the couple.

The groom’s family has lodged a complaint against the bride’s family. Police have begun an investigation, examining mobile phone locations and CCTV footage to trace Pallavi’s movements.

articles.title: Meerut Shock: Doctor Uses Feviquick Instead of Stitches on Toddler’s Eye Injury; Probe Ordered
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case of medical negligence has emerged from Uttar Pradesh’s Meerut, where a doctor at a private hospital allegedly applied Feviquick instead of stitching a deep wound near the eye of a two-and-a-half-year-old child.

body.html:
A shocking case of medical negligence has emerged from Uttar Pradesh’s Meerut, where a doctor at a private hospital allegedly applied Feviquick instead of stitching a deep wound near the eye of a two-and-a-half-year-old child.

The child’s mother, Irvin Kaur, said the toddler, Manraj Singh, was injured after bumping into a table corner while playing. The family rushed him to Bhagyashree Hospital, where the doctor shockingly asked the father to bring Feviquick and applied it directly on the bleeding wound without cleaning it.

When the parents demanded proper treatment, including an injection and dressing, the doctor dismissed it as unnecessary.

The next morning, the worried parents took the child to another hospital. Doctors there spent three hours removing the strong adhesive before stitching the wound properly.

The child’s father has filed a complaint with the Chief Medical Officer. Meerut CMO Dr. Ashok Kataria confirmed receiving the complaint and said an inquiry committee has been formed. Action will be taken against those found responsible.
